subject: How to select data files in the server?

messages.author: 185e9790ec4afcf9
messages.subject: How to select data files in the server?
parts:
Hi

I'm a recent shiny user and I have to say it opened a new world for me. Now I want to build an app that will run on a local server, it can only be accessed from work, to read and plot some datasets.

I have searched through Google and found how to upload a data file from my computer to the shiny server but I couldn't find how to choose among a list of files that are stored on the shiny server. Can you point me to any documentation or examples so I can adapt to my case?

Things like

  sidebarPanel(
  selectInput(inputId = "file1",
              label = "Choose Dataset",
              filenames  ),

  data = reactive({
    in.file = input$file1
    read.csv(in.file$datapath, header="TRUE", sep=";",na.strings="-99.900")

didn't work for me, maybe it was my fault or maybe it is not the right way.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 80ac11e65419558c
messages.subject: Re: How to select data files in the server?
parts:
Hi,

I did something similar and it worked, try the code below?

getFilenames <- reactive({
  filenames <- list.files() # assuming the files you want to read in are in your root folder
  names(filenames) <- gsub("\\.csv", "", filenames)
  return(filenames)
}

choices = getFilenames()),

  data <- reactive({
    in.file = input$file1
    data <- read.csv(in.file, header=TRUE, sep=";",na.strings="-99.900") # drop "$datapath"
  })

messages.subject: Re: How to select data files in the server?
parts:
Oh just a note, I think if you happen to generate/save new files into the same directory in the process of doing things in your app, I think the selectInput dropdown list doesn't change to reflect the new files unless you refresh the app.

- JinRou

getFilenames <- reactive({
